theorem open_domain_quadratic_tilt_boundary_coordinate_jet
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (theta : ℝ × ℝ)
    (htheta : theta ∈ interior
      (Shao.Probability.bivariateMGFDomain mu (fun x : ℝ => (x, x ^ 2))))
    (hdet : (parabolaCovariance
      (mu.tilted (fun x => theta.1 * x + theta.2 * x ^ 2))).det ≠ 0)
    (level a0 : ℝ) (hlevel : 0 < level) (ha0 : 0 < a0) (hnegative : theta.2 < 0)
    (hmean : (∫ x : ℝ, x ∂mu.tilted (fun x => theta.1 * x + theta.2 * x ^ 2),
      ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂mu.tilted (fun x => theta.1 * x + theta.2 * x ^ 2)) =
        (a0, a0 ^ 2 / level ^ 2))
    (hsaddle : theta.1 = -2 * a0 * theta.2 / level ^ 2) :
    let Omega : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := interior
      (Shao.Probability.bivariateMGFDomain mu (fun x : ℝ => (x, x ^ 2)))
    let nu : (ℝ × ℝ) → Measure ℝ := fun p =>
      mu.tilted (fun x => p.1 * x + p.2 * x ^ 2)
    let means : (ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ) := fun p =>
      (∫ x : ℝ, x ∂nu p, ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂nu p)
    let K : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := fun p => Real.log
      (∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (p.1 * x + p.2 * x ^ 2) ∂mu)
    let D : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := parabolaCovariance (nu theta)
    let pr0 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ
    let pr1 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ
    let row0 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := D 0 0 • pr0 + D 0 1 • pr1
    let row1 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := D 0 1 • pr0 + D 1 1 • pr1
    let B : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) :=
      pr0.prod ((2 * a0 / level ^ 2) • pr0 - pr1)
    ∃ L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ),
      ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ),
      (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) = row0.prod row1 ∧
      (e : (ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ)) = means ∧
      theta ∈ e.source ∧ means theta ∈ e.target ∧ e.source ⊆ Omega ∧
      let J : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := fun z =>
        (e.symm z).1 * z.1 + (e.symm z).2 * z.2 - K (e.symm z)
      let G : (ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ) := fun w =>
        (a0 + w.1, (a0 + w.1) ^ 2 / level ^ 2 - w.2)
      let F : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := fun w => J (G w)
      0 < -theta.2 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F (0, 0) ∧
        HasFDerivAt F ((-theta.2) • pr1) (0, 0) ∧
        (∀ u v : ℝ × ℝ,
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ F w) (0, 0) u) v =
            (L.symm (B u)).1 * (B v).1 + (L.symm (B u)).2 * (B v).2 +
              (2 * theta.2 / level ^ 2) * u.1 * v.1) ∧
        ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (0, 0),
          Shao.Probability.bivariateLegendreRate mu (fun x : ℝ => (x, x ^ 2)) (G w) = (F w : EReal)

theorem exists_uniform_cubic_taylor_bound_at_zero
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g 0) :
    ∃ rho C : ℝ, 0 < rho ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho →
      |g r - g 0 - (deriv g 0) * r - (deriv (deriv g) 0) / 2 * r ^ 2| ≤
        C * |r| ^ 3

theorem exists_uniform_normal_increment_bound_at_zero
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (0, 0)) :
    ∃ rho C : ℝ, 0 < rho ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ r z : ℝ,
      |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |F (r, z) - F (r, 0) - (fderiv ℝ F (0, 0) (0, 1)) * z| ≤
        C * (|r| * z + z ^ 2)

theorem exists_uniform_boundary_taylor_bound_at_zero
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 3 F (0, 0)) :
    ∃ rho C : ℝ, 0 < rho ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ r z : ℝ,
      |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |F (r, z) - F (0, 0) - (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (t, 0)) 0) * r -
        (fderiv ℝ F (0, 0) (0, 1)) * z -
        (deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (t, 0))) 0) / 2 * r ^ 2| ≤
        C * (|r| ^ 3 + |r| * z + z ^ 2)

theorem exists_positive_boundary_lower_bound_of_taylor
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (lambda Lambda1 rho C : ℝ)
    (hlambda : 0 < lambda) (hLambda1 : 0 < Lambda1)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hbound : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |F (r, z) - F (0, 0) - lambda * z - Lambda1 / 2 * r ^ 2| ≤
        C * (|r| ^ 3 + |r| * z + z ^ 2)) :
    ∃ delta c : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧ delta ≤ rho ∧ 0 < c ∧ ∀ r z : ℝ,
      |r| ≤ delta → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ delta →
      c * (z + r ^ 2) ≤ F (r, z) - F (0, 0)

theorem exists_positive_boundary_lower_bound_of_contDiffAt
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 3 F (0, 0))
    (htangent : deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (t, 0)) 0 = 0)
    (hnormal : 0 < fderiv ℝ F (0, 0) (0, 1))
    (hcurvature : 0 < deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (t, 0))) 0) :
    ∃ delta c : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧ 0 < c ∧ ∀ r z : ℝ,
      |r| ≤ delta → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ delta →
      c * (z + r ^ 2) ≤ F (r, z) - F (0, 0)

        (parabolaCovariance (mu.tilted (fun x => p.1 * x + p.2 * x ^ 2))).det)

theorem open_domain_chart_covariance_amplitude
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (theta : ℝ × ℝ)
    (htheta : theta ∈ interior
      (Shao.Probability.bivariateMGFDomain mu (fun x : ℝ => (x, x ^ 2))))
    (level a0 : ℝ) (hlevel : 0 < level) (ha0 : 0 < a0)
    (hmean : (∫ x : ℝ, x ∂mu.tilted (fun x => theta.1 * x + theta.2 * x ^ 2),
      ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂mu.tilted (fun x => theta.1 * x + theta.2 * x ^ 2)) =
        (a0, a0 ^ 2 / level ^ 2))
    (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ))
    (he : (e : (ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ)) = fun p =>
      (∫ x : ℝ, x ∂mu.tilted (fun x => p.1 * x + p.2 * x ^ 2),
        ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂mu.tilted (fun x => p.1 * x + p.2 * x ^ 2)))
    (hsource : theta ∈ e.source)
    (hpositive : 0 < (parabolaCovariance
      (mu.tilted (fun x => theta.1 * x + theta.2 * x ^ 2))).det) :
    let Omega : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := interior
      (Shao.Probability.bivariateMGFDomain mu (fun x : ℝ => (x, x ^ 2)))
    let G : (ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ) := fun w =>
      (a0 + w.1, (a0 + w.1) ^ 2 / level ^ 2 - w.2)
    let P : (ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ) := fun w => e.symm (G w)
    let detF : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := fun w =>
      (parabolaCovariance
        (mu.tilted (fun x => (P w).1 * x + (P w).2 * x ^ 2))).det
    let A : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := fun w => (Real.sqrt (detF w))⁻¹
    P (0, 0) = theta ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ P (0, 0) ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A (0, 0) ∧
      A (0, 0) = (Real.sqrt (parabolaCovariance
        (mu.tilted (fun x => theta.1 * x + theta.2 * x ^ 2))).det)⁻¹ ∧
      ∃ rho C : ℝ, 0 < rho ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ r z : ℝ,
        |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
        P (r, z) ∈ Omega ∧ 0 < detF (r, z) ∧
          |A (r, z) - A (0, 0)| ≤ C * (|r| + z)

theorem abs_exp_neg_sub_exp_neg_le
    (a b d : ℝ) (ha : d ≤ a) (hb : d ≤ b) :
    |Real.exp (-a) - Real.exp (-b)| ≤ Real.exp (-d) * |a - b|

theorem abs_weighted_exp_neg_sub_le
    (a b w w0 d E Q : ℝ) (ha : d ≤ a) (hb : d ≤ b)
    (hexponent : |a - b| ≤ E) (hamplitude : |w - w0| ≤ Q) :
    |w * Real.exp (-a) - w0 * Real.exp (-b)| ≤
      (Q + |w0| * E) * Real.exp (-d)

theorem boundary_taylor_scaled_error
    (F : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (lambda Lambda1 rho CF : ℝ) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF)
    (hbound : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |F (r, z) - F (0, 0) - lambda * z - Lambda1 / 2 * r ^ 2| ≤
        CF * (|r| ^ 3 + |r| * z + z ^ 2))
    (t u v : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hru : |t * u| ≤ rho) (hzv : t ^ 2 * v ≤ rho) :
    |(F (t * u, t ^ 2 * v) - F (0, 0)) / t ^ 2 -
      (lambda * v + Lambda1 / 2 * u ^ 2)| ≤
      CF * t * (|u| ^ 3 + |u| * v + v ^ 2)

theorem boundary_weighted_scaled_kernel_error
    (F A : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (lambda Lambda1 rho CF CA c d : ℝ)
    (hCF : 0 ≤ CF) (hCA : 0 ≤ CA) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdc : d ≤ c) (hdl : d ≤ lambda) (hdq : d ≤ Lambda1 / 2)
    (hbound : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |F (r, z) - F (0, 0) - lambda * z - Lambda1 / 2 * r ^ 2| ≤
        CF * (|r| ^ 3 + |r| * z + z ^ 2))
    (hmargin : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      c * (z + r ^ 2) ≤ F (r, z) - F (0, 0))
    (hamplitude : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |A (r, z) - A (0, 0)| ≤ CA * (|r| + z))
    (t u v : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hru : |t * u| ≤ rho) (hzv : t ^ 2 * v ≤ rho) :
    |A (t * u, t ^ 2 * v) *
        Real.exp (-((F (t * u, t ^ 2 * v) - F (0, 0)) / t ^ 2)) -
      A (0, 0) * Real.exp (-(lambda * v + Lambda1 / 2 * u ^ 2))| ≤
      t * (CA * (|u| + v) + |A (0, 0)| * CF * (|u| ^ 3 + |u| * v + v ^ 2)) *
        Real.exp (-d * (v + u ^ 2))

theorem boundary_weighted_scaled_cutoff_error
    (F A : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (lambda Lambda1 rho CF CA c d : ℝ)
    (hCF : 0 ≤ CF) (hCA : 0 ≤ CA) (hrho : 0 < rho) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdc : d ≤ c) (hdl : d ≤ lambda) (hdq : d ≤ Lambda1 / 2)
    (hbound : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |F (r, z) - F (0, 0) - lambda * z - Lambda1 / 2 * r ^ 2| ≤
        CF * (|r| ^ 3 + |r| * z + z ^ 2))
    (hmargin : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      c * (z + r ^ 2) ≤ F (r, z) - F (0, 0))
    (hamplitude : ∀ r z : ℝ, |r| ≤ rho → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ rho →
      |A (r, z) - A (0, 0)| ≤ CA * (|r| + z))
    (t u v : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    |(if |t * u| ≤ rho ∧ t ^ 2 * v ≤ rho then
        A (t * u, t ^ 2 * v) *
          Real.exp (-((F (t * u, t ^ 2 * v) - F (0, 0)) / t ^ 2)) else 0) -
      A (0, 0) * Real.exp (-(lambda * v + Lambda1 / 2 * u ^ 2))| ≤
      t * (CA * (|u| + v) + |A (0, 0)| * CF * (|u| ^ 3 + |u| * v + v ^ 2) +
        |A (0, 0)| / rho * (|u| + v)) *
        Real.exp (-d * (v + u ^ 2))
